description: This is a bash shell script designed for generating U-Boot FIT images (.its files). The script processes multiple images (kernel, device tree, ramdisk), applying configurations such as compression, hashing, and signatures, to produce a structured .its file suitable for bootloader use.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command-line options for the script.

methods.name: array_check
methods.description: Validates array indices for images or configurations.

methods.name: array_put
methods.description: Assigns a value to an array element, with optional appending.

methods.name: array_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from an array element.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to configure image and configuration parameters.

methods.name: value_sanity_chk
methods.description: Checks validity of signature, hash, and compression options.

methods.name: emit_its
methods.description: Outputs sections of the .its file, such as headers, images, configurations, and section end.

methods.name: emit_kernel
methods.description: Writes a kernel image node into the .its file, including associated checksum and signature.

methods.name: emit_fdt
methods.description: Writes a device tree blob (FDT) node into the .its file.

methods.name: emit_ramdisk
methods.description: Writes a ramdisk node into the .its file.

methods.name: emit_signature
methods.description: Outputs signature subnodes for images, signatures, and keys.

methods.name: emit_config
methods.description: Writes configuration nodes for various boot images with their associated parameters and signatures.

methods.name: remove_prefix_space
methods.description: Removes leading spaces from a string.

methods.name: emit_image_nodes
methods.description: Generates image nodes (kernel, fdt, ramdisk) for the .its file, including subnodes and configurations.

methods.name: emit_configuration_nodes
methods.description: Generates configuration nodes for different image configurations, including signatures.
